entities.name: Roil
entities.description: Periodic volatility of Zendikar's earth and climate resulting from its mana.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: Led the elementalists who used the Roil as a weapon.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Guilt-ridden planeswalker who sought to destroy the Roil; later compleated.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker who befriended elementals and restored Zendikar with the Lithoform Core.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: Device Nissa used to restore Zendikar.

entities.name: Rise of the Eldrazi
entities.description: Event during which the Roil intensified.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Zendikar was targeted.

events.summary: Elementalists led by Noyan Dar used the Roil as a weapon against the Eldrazi.
events.quote: the elementalists led by Noyan Dar used the Roil as a weapon

events.summary: Nahiri sought to destroy the Roil, clashing with Nissa Revane, who prevailed and restored Zendikar with the Lithoform Core.
events.quote: In the end, Nissa Revane prevailed

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the Roil rose against the compleated Nahiri, who turned a landscape to stone.
events.quote: She managed to counteract its effects by turning an entire landscape into stone.

relations.quote: setting her on a path of conflict with Nissa Revane
